description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win immediately in column 5 (the playable cell on top of column 5 completes their four), most strongly when their last move stacked a vertical three in column 5. Threat cells low in column 5 (rows 0-2, e.g. bottom-row horizontal threes) and the same threat in other columns give little or no activation; my own immediate win elsewhere suppresses it. Weak firing (0.7-4) is diffuse and partly unexplained.
effect: When strongly active it pushes the model to play column 5 (block): forcing max moved col 5 from 0.11 to 1.00 in 4,2,4,1 and from 0.01 to 0.76 in a late-game position; zeroing it barely changes forced blocks (redundant).
notes: Top bands (act>4) are almost all column-5 must-blocks (vertical three in col 5: precision 0.97). Vertical threes in other columns: mostly no firing (p2 precision 0.23). Best dev F1 0.478 (P 0.735, R 0.354) with 'col-5 must-block at row>=3'. Two thirds of firing positions are in the weak 0.7-4.3 band, which I could not characterize. Simulation share is negative (~-18 of a 17.4% ceiling) for every level scheme tried. Synthesis max 38.7 < dev max 41.3.
